reading: The 28 SRG(40,12,2,4) share the Seidel spectrum {15,-5^24,7^15} AND the Seidel Smith group Z/3(+)(Z/5)^23(+)Z/25(+)(Z/7)^15 -- a genuine switching invariant -- yet they split into the ladder {17,8,2,1} by the 2-rank of the adjacency matrix.  So the arithmetic ladder is strictly finer than (transverse to) the two-graph switching class: it distinguishes graphs the two-graph cannot.  W(3,3) is generic (2-rank 16); Q(4,3) is the unique minimum-2-rank member (rank 10, its maximal glue of Pass 94).  The (Z/5)^23 echoes the critical group's constant 5-part (Pass 89).
